purpose: Keep duplicate loot as distinct possessions and convert selected retained possessions into learning resources without minting value through free respec, expedition copies or repeated receipts.
limits: D51 adopts multiple acquisition and lower-efficiency conversion in principle. Exact rates, value bands, point denomination and timing are trial choices.
Possessions are distinct reward receipts. Equal blueprints may be grouped for display but retain their quantity. Known blueprints and learned bases are not saleable possessions.
Conversion is performed at home after settlement in this proposal. Active preparation references or a protected possession must be removed by a separate explicit edit before sale.

Last-copy sale removes that acquired variant's availability in this proposal. Knowledge, separately learned bases and initial free options remain. No permanent acquired unlock is retained as an extra saleable copy.
One selected variant per passive base is only the inherited AO adapter used to exercise references. Multiple simultaneous effects are unresolved, not adopted by this trial.
The fractional balance is an exact integer remainder of the same growth resource, not a new exchange currency. Historical AH learning payments and full refunds are unchanged.
The value band is assigned by content independently of affix count. It is a comparison reference, not an implemented shop price or proof of a universally correct item value.
Accounting of existing AM/AN receipts holds actions and outcomes fixed. It is not a new exploration, loot distribution or strategy test. Materials are not converted under the current user request.
AM, AN and AO source and results are unchanged. Natural affix loot, full campaign integration, user interfaces and human evaluation are outside this standalone model.
